# OpenLancer engine

This repository is a fork of [Librelancer](https://codeberg.org/Librelancer/Librelancer), which is licensed under the MIT License. [OpenLancer](https://github.com/spool1/openlancer) uses this fork as its engine. OpenLancer is a mod tool and editor for Freelancer (2003).

The branch `openlancer` holds the upstream Librelancer code plus the OpenLancer changes (commits `OL-0001` and later). `docs/UPSTREAM.md` in the OpenLancer repository lists each change and its reason.

This fork is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Librelancer project. Do not report problems with this fork to Librelancer. Report them at https://github.com/spool1/openlancer/issues. The fork does not send changes upstream.

`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repository root are the upstream Librelancer files. They describe Librelancer, not this fork. Their Discord, Patreon and download links belong to the Librelancer project, and the Librelancer downloads do not contain the OpenLancer changes.

To build this fork for OpenLancer, follow "Build the submodule" in `docs/UPSTREAM.md` of the OpenLancer repository.

Librelancer is Copyright (c) Callum McGing and the Librelancer contributors. See `LICENSE` and `Credits.txt`. This repository contains no game files. You need your own copy of Freelancer (2003).
